problem_text:
A logistics manager is assembling a shipment of specialized components to maximize total utility while adhering to a cargo aircraft’s weight restriction.

The components available are:
* Component A: weight 29kg, utility 23 units
* Component B: weight 36kg, utility 203 units
* Component C: weight 2kg, utility 72 units
* Component D: weight 7kg, utility 168 units
* Component E: weight 6kg, utility 205 units
* Component F: weight 14kg, utility 141 units
* Component G: weight 47kg, utility 206 units
* Component H: weight 15kg, utility 247 units
* Component I: weight 42kg, utility 268 units
* Component J: weight 36kg, utility 198 units
* Component K: weight 12kg, utility 227 units
* Component L: weight 41kg, utility 14 units
* Component M: weight 38kg, utility 225 units
* Component N: weight 39kg, utility 129 units
* Component O: weight 19kg, utility 187 units
* Component P: weight 33kg, utility 170 units
* Component Q: weight 31kg, utility 249 units
* Component R: weight 48kg, utility 139 units
* Component S: weight 23kg, utility 149 units

Furthermore, due to compatibility requirements, exactly one of Component A and Component B must be included in the shipment.

If Component C is selected, the aircraft’s effective payload capacity is diminished by 10 kg.
The aircraft can accommodate a maximum of 362 kg. The manager must determine which components to load.
